primary_outcome.interpretation: No arm produced a surviving reproducing descendant lineage; identical zero primary outcome prevents fitness ranking.

calibration_repeat.initial_service_failure: Initial invocation failed before probe execution because PATH was absent; it produced no experiment output. Corrected service run completed.

provenance.protocol_header_note: Frozen preregistration copy retains pre-run header; the manifest and runreport record completed evaluation.

audit_checks.event_food_count_not_equated_to_food_ene: event_rows.eats counts consume events; it is not the food_eaten energy total.

limitations: Eight held-out seeds and 2000 ticks are a bounded mechanism/fitness screen, not long-term selection or acceptance evidence.
Separate fixed-genotype populations and zero mutation provide no within-population selection or adaptive evolution claim.
The summary max_generation field is derived from entities in final state and is not the historical maximum when the world is empty.
